title: More young people are getting involved with South Texas civil rights group amid Trump’s immigration crackdown
content:
Subscribe to The Y’all — a weekly dispatch about the people, places and policies defining Texas, produced by Texas Tribune journalists living in communities across the state.
PHARR — Kimberly Trujillo became a card-carrying member of La Unión del Pueblo Entero only two months ago. But already, she’s stepped into a leadership position for one of the organization’s most important events.
The 24-year-old Brownsville native served as a delegate for LUPE’s biennial Cumbre de Miembros, a convention held in August that gathers LUPE members to determine which issues the group will mobilize around and how they will prioritize them.
As a delegate, Trujillo made the case to the rest of the membership for immigration as a top priority for them. It was the issue that motivated her to join LUPE, a community nonprofit, in the first place.
“I was really inspired by the work they were doing,” Trujillo said. “Seeing a campaign so dedicated to letting people know what their rights are, especially now amongst really harsh immigration enforcement, was important to me.”
Not surprisingly, the members voted immigration as its top priority at the organization’s convention this year.
Trujillo, like many her age, became involved with LUPE as immigrant communities across the nation face increased arrests and enforcement actions under President Donald Trump.
Participation in LUPE’s cumbre nearly doubled from 99 people in 2024 — the time it was held previously — to 197 in 2026, driven largely by an increase in members under the age of 45.
Getting involved
Trujillo first got involved by volunteering with LUPE in February after learning about a Know-Your-Rights campaign that the organization had launched in December.
The campaign, called “Valle Fuerte, Valle Libre,” consisted of distributing kits to the public that contained information about their rights in case they encountered officers with U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement.
The Valle Fuerte campaign helped usher a shift in its membership, motivating younger people like Trujillo to get involved, said Tania Chavez Camacho, executive director of LUPE.
“We’ve actually seen a change,” Chavez Camacho said. “We’ve seen a lot of young people … and that has been surprising for us.”
This year, members under 45 years old made up the largest share of cumbre participants at 35%. Members between 45 and 64 years old made up 34%, while those 65 and older 32%.
Going by raw numbers alone, the membership participation in the cumbre of those under 45 years old also saw a significant increase, adding 36 to those who participated in this year’s cumbre. The 45 to 64 age group and the 65 and over each grew by 31 member participants.
The growth in participation this year prompted the group to shift its cumbre convention from its headquarters in San Juan, Texas, to a larger community center in Pharr. This increase in engagement comes despite fear among some in their ranks of being targeted by U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement.
Involvement with the group comes despite disturbing allegations that were unearthed earlier this year against one of LUPE’s founders — Cesar Chavez. In March, the New York Times published accounts that Chavez, one of the most revered Latino civil rights leaders, sexually assaulted several girls and women, including Dolores Huerta who co-founded LUPE with Chavez.
Following the allegations, LUPE covered up a mural that pictured Chavez. The group also did not participate in any Cesar Chavez Day activities.
LUPE directors say the organization’s mission remains central to keeping its community safe.
“As an organization led by women, we knew the profound impact it would have on our community,” said a LUPE spokesperson said of news of the allegations against Chavez. “It was a moment to move intentionally, listen and learn from each other, and ground ourselves in our values of hope and justice.”
Despite the controversy that it caused, young LUPE members are still focused on the work that lies ahead.
“Their commitment lies with the issues impacting them currently, and that is leading the advocacy in the community organizing they participate in,” LUPE said. “Second to healing and facing this painful truth about Cesar Chavez, the historical preservation of the farmworker movement has been a concern for our membership, especially our movement elders who all contributed to the foundation of this work.
Taking action
As immigration enforcement increased in the Rio Grande Valley last fall, LUPE members began looking for ways to respond, said Dani Marrero Hi, deputy director of LUPE. That prompted LUPE to launch the Valle Fuerte, Valle Libre campaign, which focused on raising awareness of immigration arrests and providing residents with information about their rights.
“We wanted to give people something practical to do because there was so much anger,” she said.
It was particularly useful for people like Trujillo — those who are U.S. citizens or have some type of protected status and want to take action in support of those who are vulnerable to deportation and may not feel safe advocating for themselves.
In other places across the country, the issue of immigration has been a motivating factor for some Latinos, citing it as the most important issue for them in elections.
Outside elections, events like the cumbre provide Trujillo and others an opportunity to effectuate change in her community. And the organization is not just focused on immigration.
The members voted the economy as their second-highest priority, followed by health. Their other top issues, in order of priority, include civic participation, infrastructure, LGBTQ issues, youth education and unity and solidarity.
“It’s a testament to what’s a concern to the broader membership,” Chavez Camacho said.
During the event, the issues were presented in the form of resolutions that were formulated over months by working groups in the lead-up to the cumbre.
As the head of the immigration delegation, Trujillo and her group brainstormed actions they could take to address issues undocumented immigrants currently face.
Their goals include increasing transparency between public officials and the community and electing people who will value their members. They’re increasing awareness of constitutional rights among the public as much as possible.
“Our drive for this is that we think no one is free until we are all free, and so that really drove a lot of the components of our resolution,” Trujillo said.
Another change to the cumbre this year was that after the vote on the resolutions, the working groups broke off into groups to make definitive plans to decide what direction to take on their priorities.
The civic engagement team, for example, is tasked with coming up with a guided direction on which legislation they will engage with state lawmakers on during the 2027 legislative session.
Navigating current events
Given the increase of immigration enforcement, LUPE members and event attendees now ask before events whether ICE agents could be there.
Marrero said the organization couldn’t guarantee that agents won’t show up, but said LUPE’s events attract large numbers of people and doesn’t expect ICE to target one of its events.
“Ultimately, people have to make that personal decision of, ‘Well, I’m already living in so much fear, what else do I have left than to fight? What else do I have left than to fight for my family?” Marrero said. “I think that’s why we’re seeing so much member engagement.”
Organizing under the heightened attention and targeting of people who are undocumented has not been easy for the group, said Chavez Camacho, LUPE’s executive director. But, organizing has always had its challenges, she said, and addressing these issues is part of the reason LUPE exists in the first place.
“We are here to help advance the issues of the community through power building, and who has the power? The people,” she said.

title: Mali : l'hôpital de Sikasso et dix artisans dotés d'installations solaires pour sécuriser leur approvisionnement
content:
Mali : l'hôpital de Sikasso et dix artisans dotés d'installations solaires pour sécuriser leur approvisionnement
Dans le cadre des œuvres sociales de la présidence, l'hôpital régional de Sikasso et dix artisans ont reçu des équipements solaires pour garantir leur approvisionnement électrique.
Dans le cadre des œuvres sociales du Président de la Transition, le Général d’Armée Assimi Goïta, l'hôpital régional de Sikasso et dix maîtres artisans ont été dotés, samedi 19 septembre 2026, d'équipements photovoltaïques destinés à sécuriser durablement leur alimentation électrique.
Le Conseiller spécial du Chef de l'État, Aguibou Dembélé, a procédé à l'inauguration de l'installation photovoltaïque de l'hôpital régional de Sikasso ainsi qu'à la remise officielle d'équipements solaires à dix maîtres artisans de la troisième région administrative du Mali. La cérémonie s'est déroulée en présence de la Gouverneure de la région, Marie Claire Dembélé, des autorités et légitimités traditionnelles, ainsi que de la délégation des œuvres sociales venue de Bamako.
D'une capacité de 1 075 kWh, l'installation de l'hôpital, composée de panneaux photovoltaïques, de batteries de stockage et d'onduleurs intelligents, vise à garantir la continuité des soins. « Nous ne voulons plus d'arrêt des soins à cause du manque d'électricité », a déclaré Aguibou Dembélé, précisant que le Président de la Transition avait instruit l'installation de panneaux solaires dans plusieurs centres de santé à travers le pays.
La Gouverneure de Sikasso a souligné le caractère essentiel d'une électricité disponible en permanence pour l'éclairage des salles de soins, la conservation des médicaments et le fonctionnement des équipements médicaux, avant de solliciter l'octroi d'ambulances supplémentaires pour l'établissement. La Directrice générale de l'hôpital, le docteur Assetou Cissouma, a estimé que cette installation permettrait de renforcer l'alimentation électrique de la structure et d'améliorer la prise en charge des patients.
Les dix bénéficiaires, comprenant huit menuisiers métalliques, un menuisier bois et un tailleur, ont également reçu leurs équipements à l'issue de la cérémonie, marquée par la coupure du ruban symbolique et la visite des installations. L'un d'eux, Sory Diaby, a indiqué que les difficultés d'accès à l'électricité avaient jusqu'ici limité sa production. Les bénéficiaires ont par ailleurs formulé des vœux pour la stabilité, la paix et la croissance économique du Mali.

title: Sanningskommissionen klar – Birgitta läser vittnesmål vid överlämnandet
content:
Sanningskommissionen klar – Birgitta läser vittnesmål vid överlämnandet
Birgitta Ricklund är en av fyra som ska läsa vittnesmålen, när Sanningskommissionens berättelsebok överlämnas nästa vecka till regeringen.
– Det jag ska läsa kommer inte från mig utan från oss som grupp; vi samer, säger hon.
Vittnesmålen kommer att läsas upp nästa onsdag, då Sanningskommissionen samlas i Staare/Östersund. Då ska samiska erfarenheter av den historiska men också nutida statliga politiken synliggöras.
– Det känns stort och viktigt, säger Birgitta Ricklund som är ordförande i Sameföreningen i Örnsköldsvik och själv har lämnat vittnesmål till kommissionen.
Berättelseboken ”Jag frågar marken tyst om lov” är en dokumentation, som sätter ord på historisk rasism och assimileringspolitik.
Upprättelse och försoning
Liksom i Norge och Finland är det meningen att Sanningskommissionens arbete ska vara grunden för framtida diskussioner om upprättelse och försoning.
Förutom Birgitta Ricklund förmedlas vittnesmålen av Hugo Bengtsson, Ella Ristin Rimpi, Peter Steggo och av Sara-Elvira Kuhmunen.
– Jag känner ju verkligen att det här får de inte släppa, för jag och många andra har ju blottat oss och lämnat ifrån oss en berättelse, säger Birgitta Ricklund.
Överlämningen sker på onsdagseftermiddagen på Gaskeuniversitete/Mittuniversitetet. Eftersom platserna är begränsade, därför kommer ceremonin att livesändas. Mer information finns på Sanningskommissionens hemsida.

SVT:s nyheter ska stå för saklighet och opartiskhet. Det vi publicerar ska vara sant och relevant. Vid akuta nyhetslägen kan det vara svårt att få alla fakta bekräftade, då ska vi berätta vad vi vet – och inte vet. Läs mer om hur vi arbetar.

title: Colombia Recovers Four Bodies From Plane Crash in Risaralda as Search Continues for Pilot
content:
The Colombian Air Force recovered the bodies of four health professionals killed in a Cessna T206 crash in Pueblo Rico, Risaralda, completing the most difficult stage of a recovery operation in steep, rain-soaked mountain terrain.
The Colombian Aerospace Force (FAC) extracted the bodies of Julissa Figueredo, Perla Constanza Alvarez, Sandy Garcia and Maria Victoria Guzman on Sept. 19. The body of pilot Mehmet Cankaya remained at the crash site, with authorities planning to resume the extraction operation on Sept. 20.
President Abelardo de la Espriella said Sept. 19 that the government was accompanying the victims’ families and honored the four women and the pilot for their humanitarian work. He expressed condolences and described the crash as a profound loss for the country’s health and volunteer communities.
Nuestra Fuerza Aérea Colombiana acaba de recuperar en el Chocó los cuerpos de las cuatro doctoras que perdieron la vida mientras cumplían una misión médica para atender a los damnificados por el terremoto.
— Abelardo De La Espriella (@ABDELAESPRIELLA) September 19, 2026
El cuerpo del piloto no pude ser recuperado hoy, pero se hará mañana sin… pic.twitter.com/d7CIzK9zZC
The aircraft crashed on a mountainside in the Tatama National Natural Park, in Pueblo Rico, Risaralda, near the border with Choco. The location made a conventional ground recovery extremely difficult and forced the FAC to use helicopters, rescue cables and specialized personnel.
Helicopters and rope systems enabled the recovery
Recovery teams reached the crash site using UH-60 Black Hawk helicopters equipped for rescue operations. Because the aircraft came down on a steep slope where helicopters could not land, personnel were lowered by cable and then moved across the terrain to reach the wreckage.
Rescuers also installed rope systems to move through the mountain and extract the bodies. The FAC prepared teams to stay in the area for several days because persistent rain and the terrain could prevent helicopters from returning to extract them.
Search crews faced near-vertical 90-degree terrain at the recovery site. Dense vegetation and persistent rainfall further slowed efforts to move equipment and bodies through the area.
The operation continued for several days after authorities confirmed the deaths of all five occupants. The bodies were taken initially to San Mateo Battalion in Pereira. From there, the bodies are scheduled for transfer to Bogota for forensic examination before being released to their families.
Victims included four health professionals and the pilot
The four women were part of a volunteer medical mission traveling to Condoto, Choco. Figueredo worked as a medical radiologist at Clinica del Country, a major private hospital in Bogota. Alvarez leveraged her background in nursing in her role as assistant manager of medical agreements at Colmedica, a major Colombian healthcare provider. Garcia was a head nurse, while Guzman was a physician and pediatrician who worked as a medical auditor for Colmedica. Following her death, Universidad del Rosario confirmed Guzman’s medical and pediatric credentials.
The mission brought together 33 volunteers and treated about 600 people in Condoto, according to Pamela Estrada, director of the Colombian Civil Air Patrol. The organization has coordinated medical brigades with Colmedica and Clinica del Country for more than a decade.
The work continued after the earthquake that struck the region in August, when medical teams traveled to communities with limited access to health services. The four women were returning to Bogota when the aircraft crashed.
Cankaya, a Turkish businessman who had lived in Colombia for 11 years, also participated in humanitarian flights through the Colombian Civil Air Patrol. Caracol Radio reported that he founded the tourism company MegaTravel in Colombia and had developed a parallel career as a pilot.
Colombian Civil Air Patrol will continue its medical brigades
The accident has not led the Colombian Civil Air Patrol to suspend its humanitarian missions. Estrada said the organization will continue dispatching medical teams to underserved communities. The decision preserves a long-standing program that pairs volunteer healthcare professionals with pilots to reach isolated regions.
The Colombian Civil Air Patrol has operated for about six decades, bringing medical services to vulnerable communities across Colombia. The Condoto brigade was one of its regular missions, with volunteers providing care before the group began its return journey.
Colombia’s Civil Aviation Authority (Aerocivil) continues investigating the circumstances of the crash. No official finding establishing the cause of the accident had been released.
The recovery operation remained focused on Cankaya’s body as authorities prepared to return to the crash site on Sept. 20.

title: School-based HPV vaccination campaign in a French region during the 2024-2025 school year: Incentives deployed and analysis of parental consent return.
content: To describe parental consent return for HPV vaccination among seventh-grade students (ages 12-13) in the French region of Nouvelle-Aquitaine during the 2024-2025 school vaccination campaign. In September 2024, 12,023 consents were obtained, representing a decrease compared with the previous school year. To address this decline, the digital consent platform was reopened between January 20 and March 10, 2025, supported by weekly monitoring using a three-color indicator and regular coordination with the three regional education authorities and the Regional Health Agency. During this reopening period, 1506 additional consents were collected. In parallel, a communication strategy based on social marketing was deployed. By the end of the school year, 13,714 consents had been obtained, leading to the vaccination of 10,607 seventh-grade students. These measures partially offset the initial decline in consents and suggest that real-time monitoring with tailored communication can improve campaign effectiveness.

title: Côte d’Ivoire-AIP/Banque mondiale : le PAGDS présente ses réalisations dans la digitalisation des services publics
content:
Abidjan, 21 sept 2026 (AIP) – Le Projet d’amélioration de la gouvernance pour la délivrance des services de base aux citoyens (PAGDS) a mis en avant lundi 21 septembre 2026 à Abidjan plusieurs acquis enregistrés dans la digitalisation des services publics, notamment dans l’éducation, la santé, les finances et la mobilisation des recettes.
La coordinatrice du PAGDS, Yao Madeleine, a présenté ces résultats lors des Journées portes ouvertes de la Banque mondiale en Côte d’Ivoire, organisées les 21 et 22 septembre à Abidjan.
Mis en œuvre pendant six ans, le PAGDS est intervenu dans plusieurs secteurs, dont les finances, l’éducation nationale, la santé, la justice, les infrastructures et la bonne gouvernance. Le projet visait notamment à améliorer la gestion des ressources publiques et la qualité des services délivrés aux citoyens.
Dans le secteur de l’éducation, le projet a contribué à la digitalisation de l’affectation et du suivi des élèves dans les établissements privés. Des dispositifs de contrôle de présence ont également été introduits pour améliorer le suivi des élèves effectivement pris en charge par l’Etat.
La Banque mondiale avait notamment relevé, dans son bilan d’étape, une progression du nombre d’élèves effectivement affectés et suivis électroniquement dans les établissements privés, ainsi qu’une amélioration de la disponibilité des manuels de lecture et de mathématiques.
Le projet a également soutenu la mise en place de solutions d’enseignement à distance afin de contribuer à réduire les difficultés liées au déficit d’enseignants dans certaines disciplines, selon Mme Yao.
Dans le domaine de la santé, le PAGDS a contribué au développement d’outils numériques destinés à améliorer le suivi du parcours des patients, notamment dans le cadre de la Couverture maladie universelle (CMU).
La digitalisation a également concerné les finances publiques avec le développement de solutions de paiement électronique et d’inclusion financière. La Banque mondiale a fait état d’une progression de la numérisation de certains flux de paiement entre l’Etat et les particuliers.
Le projet est aussi intervenu dans la mobilisation des recettes fiscales et douanières. Selon les résultats publiés par la Banque mondiale, les recettes fiscales hors recettes pétrolières, gazières et frais d’enregistrement du café-cacao ont enregistré une progression moyenne de 12,4 %, contre un objectif intermédiaire de 5 %. Les recettes douanières ont progressé de 19,2 %, pour un objectif de 6 %.
Dans le domaine de la justice, des dispositifs numériques ont par ailleurs été développés pour faciliter les démarches liées à la création d’entreprises.
« Nous avons travaillé et réalisé des projets au niveau des finances, de la santé, de l’éducation, de la justice et de la bonne gouvernance », a expliqué Mme Yao Madeleine, soulignant le caractère transversal du projet.
La coordinatrice du PAGDS a indiqué que les résultats enregistrés ont permis l’entrée en vigueur d’une deuxième phase du projet.
Le PAGDS avait été approuvé par la Banque mondiale en avril 2019 et est entré en vigueur en juin de la même année. Son objectif a ensuite été révisé pour renforcer la mobilisation et la gestion des ressources publiques ainsi que l’amélioration de la fourniture de services dans plusieurs secteurs.
Les Journées portes ouvertes de la Banque mondiale visent notamment à présenter au public les interventions et les résultats des projets financés par l’institution en Côte d’Ivoire et à donner davantage de visibilité aux réalisations et aux bénéficiaires.
(AIP)

title: Apramp localizó a cerca de 4.000 personas en riesgo de explotación sexual y trata en el primer semestre de 2026
content:
Apramp localizó a casi 4.000 personas en riesgo de explotación sexual y trata en los primeros seis meses de 2026
Basado en hechos observados y verificados directamente por nuestros periodistas o por fuentes informadas.
Elígenos como tu fuente preferida en Google.
Con motivo del Día Internacional contra la Trata y la Explotación Sexual, la ONG reivindica una "respuesta conjunta" para prevenir nuevas situaciones de explotación y garantizar la protección de las víctimas, que en su mayoría son mujeres y niñas.
Solo en el primer semestre de 2026, los diferentes dispositivos de Apramp localizaron a un total de 3.963 personas en situación de riesgo de explotación sexual y trata de personas a las que la organización ha informado y asesorado. Es el balance que hace la ONG en un comunicado difundido con motivo del Día Internacional contra la Trata y la Explotación Sexual, que se conmemora este 23 de septiembre, y en el que reivindica también una "respuesta conjunta" para prevenir nuevas situaciones de explotación y garantizar la protección de las víctimas, que en su mayoría son mujeres y niñas.
"La explotación sexual de mujeres y niñas no comienza cuando se hace visible la violencia y el control, empieza mucho antes: al otro lado de la pantalla, con una oferta de empleo aparentemente legítima, una relación afectiva tóxica marcada por el chantaje emocional o, simplemente, la promesa de una vida mejor", subraya la entidad, que advierte de que de esas "falsas promesas" se esconden "estrategias diseñadas para aprovecharse de situaciones de vulnerabilidad" y así poder controlar y explotar posteriormente a las víctimas.
Se trata, según denuncia, de una "esclavitud en pleno siglo XXI" que se aprovecha de las necesidades vitales, de la pobreza, de las catástrofes naturales, de las situaciones de conflicto, de las carencias afectivas, de la discriminación, y, en definitiva, "de un largo etcétera de situaciones de vulnerabilidad y riesgo que presentan las personas y que los tratantes aprovechan para manipular, engañar, coaccionar y, finalmente, explotar".
Por ello, este año Apramp reivindica una "respuesta conjunta", tanto de las entidades y expertas en la atención de las víctimas, como de las administraciones y fuerzas y cuerpos de seguridad, la justicia, el temido empresarial, los medios de comunicación y la sociedad "en su conjunto". "Solo desde la corresponsabilidad será posible prevenir nuevas situaciones de explotación, garantizar la protección de las víctimas y avanzar hacia una sociedad libre de explotación".
Riesgo de trata en Ceuta
También este martes, el Consejo de Ministros ha aprobado una declaración institucional por el Día contra la Explotación Sexual, en la que pide "priorizar" la protección de las mujeres y niñas de Ceuta frente al riesgo de que caigan en "redes mafiosas" de trata.
"La situación de Ceuta exige una atención prioritaria. Las mujeres y las niñas que llegan a la ciudad lo hacen en condiciones de extrema precariedad y desprotección, circunstancias que pueden ser aprovechadas por redes mafiosas y agresores para someterlas a trata y explotación sexual. Por ello, resulta imprescindible reforzar las medidas de prevención, protección y asistencia integral, garantizando una respuesta pública firme, coordinada y centrada en sus derechos", subraya el Ejecutivo en el texto, que reconoce la explotación sexual y la trata como una "esclavitud moderna que utiliza a las personas más vulnerables como simple mercancía, violando de forma flagrante sus derechos humanos".

title: Nova SBE alarga a todo o país programa gratuito de literacia financeira
content:
Nova SBE alarga a todo o país programa gratuito de literacia financeira
Candidaturas devem de ser feitas até 16 de novembro pelas empresas que queiram formar os seus trabalhadores, sendo que este programa pode contar para as 40 horas mínimas anuais previstas na lei.
A Nova SBE decidiu alargar o seu programa de formação gratuito em literacia financeira. Nesta edição — cujas candidaturas estão abertas até 16 de novembro –, podem participar não só empresas com trabalhadores nos 50 municípios onde haverá aulas presenciais, mas também aquelas que estejam noutras regiões do país, através de formação online.
Escolha o ECO como fonte preferida no Google
“Até ao dia 16 de novembro, podem inscrever-se no programa empresas com quatro ou mais trabalhadores de todo o território de Portugal Continental. As formações do ‘Finanças para Todos Empresas’ terão início em março de 2027 e decorrerão em formato presencial em 50 municípios, sendo disponibilizadas às empresas sediadas nos restantes concelhos de Portugal Continental formações online“, anunciou esta quarta-feira a escola de negócios dirigida por Pedro Oliveira.
Esta formação será ministrada por formadores da Nova SBE e abrangerá três áreas centrais das finanças pessoais: a gestão financeira e poupança (orçamento familiar, organização financeira e preparação para imprevistos), crédito e serviços financeiros (crédito, risco de sobre-endividamento, serviços financeiros e segurança digital) e investimento e futuro financeiro (investimento e preparação da reforma).
Segundo a nota enviada às redações, este programa terá uma duração total de dez horas em horários laboral, pelo que pode ser contabilizado para o cumprimento das horas de formação previstas no Código do Trabalho.
Quanto aos municípios onde será possível fazer esta formação em formato presencial, a Nova SBE identifica os seguintes: Albergaria-a-Velha, Santa Maria da Feira, Beja, Odemira, Barcelos, Braga, Guimarães, Vila Nova de Famalicão, Bragança, Castelo Branco, Coimbra, Figueira da Foz, Faro, Loulé, Portimão, Guarda, Alcobaça, Leiria, Pombal, Alenquer, Amadora, Azambuja, Cascais, Lisboa, Loures, Mafra, Odivelas, Oeiras, Sintra, Torres Vedras, Vila Franca de Xira, Portalegre, Amarante, Felgueiras, Gondomar, Maia, Paços de Ferreira, Penafiel, Porto, Santo Tirso, Valongo, Vila do Conde, Vila Nova de Gaia, Santarém, Almada, Seixal, Setúbal, Viana do Castelo, Vila Real e Viseu. Nos restantes municípios de Portugal Continental, a formação será disponibilizada online.
Na primeira edição deste programa, inscreveram-se mais de 2.800 trabalhadores, num total de 560 empresas. Destas, a maioria (86%) encaixa na categoria de micro ou pequenas empresas. Mais de metade dos trabalhadores tinha entre 35 e 54 anos, e a participação foi mais elevada entre as mulheres do que entre os homens.
“Portugal continua a apresentar níveis de literacia financeira abaixo da média da União Europeia. Segundo dados da Comissão Europeia de 2023, apenas 42% dos adultos portugueses têm conhecimentos financeiros básicos, face a uma média europeia de 52%”, salienta a Nova SBE.
“A falta de conhecimentos financeiros pode aumentar a vulnerabilidade das famílias e afetar o bem-estar, a motivação, o absentismo e a produtividade no trabalho. Para as empresas, o ‘Finanças para Todos Empresas’ apresenta-se como uma formação sem custos que permite apoiar o bem-estar financeiro das equipas e, ao mesmo tempo, cumprir parte das obrigações legais de formação profissional enquanto, para os trabalhadores, o programa surge como uma oportunidade de ganhar autonomia e confiança em decisões do dia a dia (gerir o orçamento familiar, escolher um crédito, investir ou preparar a reforma)”, remata a escola.

title: Ukraine returns 15 civilians from Russian-occupied territories, ombudsman says
content:
Ukraine returned 15 civilians from Russian-occupied territories, Ombudsman Dmytro Lubinets said on Sept. 19.
"Leaving occupied territory is not easy. For some, it means years of waiting; for others, it means deciding to leave behind a home where they have spent their entire lives," Lubinets said on social media.
"And when someone is sick, elderly, or barely able to move on their own, the journey home becomes even more difficult."
Some civilians returned without documents because they were lost or had expired, Lubinets added.
The oldest returnee is a 96-year-old woman from the occupied village of Zaliznyi Port in Kherson Oblast. Her daughter and son-in-law returned with her.
The youngest returnee is 49, Lubinets said.
The group also includes a 74-year-old man from Kakhovka in Kherson Oblast. He had stayed in the occupied city because he feared leaving could harm his son, who was in Russian captivity. The son was returned from captivity in 2025.
The fate of thousands of Ukrainians currently in captivity, as well as those living under occupation, remains uncertain. Ukrainian authorities say up to 16,000 Ukrainians are considered missing, while Russia is holding thousands of Ukrainian civilians in detention.

title: 百年前的汉口老楼，为何被命名为"朱光亚科普馆"？
content: 武汉南京路崇正里12号，坐落着一幢砖红色的两层小楼。近百年前，中国工程院首任院长、中国科协名誉主席、"两弹一星功勋奖章"获得者朱光亚曾随父母租住于此。这里留下了这位科学大家的生活轨迹和人格精神。 9月18日，这里以"朱光亚科普馆"为名正式开馆。《中国科学报》记者来到汉口崇正里12号，推门而入，一段从长江之滨通往西北戈壁的臻荣往事徐徐展开。 武汉南京路崇正里12号朱光亚科普馆。 长江边的风华少年 1927年，因父亲朱懋功的工作调动，3岁的朱光亚随家人从湖北宜昌迁至武汉，住进了这幢离长江不远的汉口小楼。 童年时期的朱光亚便展现出了超越同龄孩童的聪慧和自控力。放学后，他便立马回到家，第一时间伏在桌前，又快又好地完成老师布置的作业。在这个天性喜欢玩耍的年龄，朱光亚的自控力和效率令他的哥哥们羡慕不已。 课余时光里，长江边便是朱光亚的游乐场。夕阳落在江面，船帆缓缓远去，年幼的朱光亚常在岸边玩耍，看水光随波摇动、波澜壮阔，母亲河的博大、温润与宁静，也慢慢养就了他宽厚柔和的性子。 据他在中国工程院工作期间的同事回忆，朱光亚与人交谈时常常面带微笑，从不摆架子。向朱光亚汇报工作时，他总是专心听着，偶尔微微点头，遇到想进一步了解的细节，才会和蔼地询问。这种平和的待人方式，给许多人都留下深刻印象。 而长江上的另一幕，也给年幼的朱光亚带来极大的震撼。"嘿！嘿！嘿......"一声声有力又充满节奏感的声音从江边传来，极目望去，一群汉子光着膀子，弯着身子，喊着号子，拉着大船，吃力地走向上游，那是长江边的纤夫。 朱光亚曾回忆，他从纤夫身上感悟了到坚毅与执着。这份坚毅与执着，也贯穿了他日后的科研生涯。 《给留美同学的一封公开信》原文。 "听吧！祖国在向我们召唤" 1937年7月7日，日本全面侵华，我国全面抗战正式开启。武汉随后成为全国抗战的重要中心，救亡运动席卷三镇。已是中学生的朱光亚也和同学们手挽着手，走上街头，高喊着"打倒日本帝国主义"的口号，投入抗日救亡运动中。 这座被爱国热血点燃的城市，将家国二字刻进了他的心里。 1942年，朱光亚从国立中央大学转入西南联大物理系。当时的校舍简陋，图书馆也常常一座难求，他便在嘈杂的茶馆里读书、演算。他各门功课优秀，在一次公认很难的无线电学考试中，他取得满分，一时轰动全系。1945年大学毕业即被遴选留校担任物理系助教。 1946年9月，22岁的朱光亚被著名物理学家吴大猷教授选中，参加政府考察团前往美国考察学习原子弹制造技术。他们漂洋过海抵达美国后，却发现美国不允许外国人进入与原子弹研制有关的机构。 计划落空，朱光亚转入密执安大学从事实验核物理的学习和研究。他成绩全部为A，每年获得奖学金。三年后，25岁的朱光亚取得博士学位，在国际著名期刊《物理评论》发表4篇论文。 不久后，新中国成立。已受美国科研项目资助、本可留在美国工作和生活的朱光亚，毅然决定回国。 1949年底，他牵头起草《给留美同学的一封公开信》，在中国留学生中争相传阅。信中那句"听吧！祖国在向我们召唤"，感染了很多人，有五十余名留学生在信上署名，表达回国决心！临行前，他拒绝美国方面提供的救济金，并且用自己的积蓄购买了一批实验器材。 1950年2月底，朱光亚登上"克利夫兰总统"号轮船，取道香港回国。 1966年12月28日，朱光亚（中）与聂荣臻元帅（左）在中国核试验基地氢弹原理试验现场。 "蘑菇云"升腾背后的四十年 1959年6月苏联拒绝向中国提供原子弹技术援助后，中共中央决定自力更生搞出原子弹。7月1日，朱光亚调入二机部北京第九研究所。接到任命那天，他在办公室里沉思许久。直到黄昏，他才起身，在小黑板上写下："不打无准备之仗，不打无把握之仗。" 随后，35岁的朱光亚被任命为研究所副所长，全面负责核武器研制中的科学技术工作。面对薄弱的研究基础和匮乏的资料设备，他组织团队分解任务、梳理难题，逐项推进。 困难时期，国内一度出现是否继续研制原子弹的争论。他主持起草两份纲领性文件，为研制工作明确技术路线、任务分工和试验安排。 1964年10月16日，罗布泊深处，倒计时声在戈壁上响起。试验人员都在等待那个决定性的瞬间。偏偏就在此时，朱光亚一行从原子弹试验铁塔最后撤离前往观测站时，司机在情急之中走错了路。当巨响传来，他们还在沙漠中疾驰。 观测站里，院长李觉四处寻找他："光亚副院长哪里去了？光亚呢？"路上的朱光亚从车里转身回望，只见蘑菇云正在升起，一向刚强内敛的他不禁潸然泪下。 当天晚上的庆功宴，一向克制的他端起酒杯，与同事们开怀畅饮。据身边人回忆，那是他一生中唯一一次喝醉。 此后，中国第一颗空投原子弹、导弹与原子弹结合试验、第一颗氢弹及第一次地下核试验相继成功，朱光亚承担着关键的科技组织和战略把关工作。 从1959年调入九所，到1999年获授"两弹一星功勋奖章"，整整40年，他是"两弹一星"元勋里，最晚被解密的"众帅之帅"。 晚年回顾自己的工作时，朱光亚只是平静地说："我这一辈子主要做的就这一件事--搞中国的核武器。" 让我们把目光收回2026年9月18日的汉口崇正里。这一天，各界人士齐聚一堂纪念朱光亚先生。朱光亚的亲属告诉《中国科学报》："朱光亚科普馆开馆意义深远，希望这座科普馆能够在青少年科学普及和爱国主义教育中发挥应有作用。" 相关机构负责人表示，下一步将扎实做好朱光亚科普馆运维管理，不断丰富展陈资源，常态化开展爱国主义教育、科学家精神宣讲和科普实践活动，让"两弹一星"精神薪火相传。 （照片均由湖北省科协提供）
